steps: Tap one of the choices. Tap again to change it.
Tap a question number on the answer sheet to jump there.
'Unanswered' lists the questions you have not answered.
Tap 'Submit' when done. It submits automatically when time runs out.
Answers are not shown during the exam. Closing the window pauses the clock.
